# Machine Learning Engineer I
Lumenfield · Full-time

What you'll do

- Ship LLM-backed features for our search product.
- Work with product and design to define evaluation criteria.
- Own a retrieval service end to end.

Requirements

- 1+ years of experience writing production Python.
- Experience building applications on large language models.
- Experience with retrieval-augmented generation and vector search.
- Solid understanding of model evaluation metrics.
- Comfortable with Git and code review.

Nice to have

- Experience with PyTorch.
- Familiarity with Docker and Kubernetes.

What we offer

- Salary range $100,000–$130,000 plus equity.
- Health, dental and vision coverage.

Lumenfield is an equal opportunity employer. Fictional posting for RightStaff tests.
